AdapterPayload.description: One runtime adapter file of the installed capabilities.
AdapterPayload.title: AdapterPayload

AgentStep.description: A visible worker step: kind and text only, never thinking, tool inputs or raw JSON.
AgentStep.title: AgentStep

ContainersPayload.description:
The read-only inventory of the configured container engine; a fact a probe could not
give is null with the probe's reason beside it.
ContainersPayload.title: ContainersPayload

HarnessOverviewReply.description:
The Harness state, the package version, the drift state and file count, the state store,
the runtime adapters (null: unreadable), the Claude Code, Codex and tracker adapters and the
runtime status (null: not collected), the container engine inventory (null: not collected) and
the pipeline usage.
HarnessOverviewReply.title: HarnessOverviewReply

HarnessStatePayload.description: What is installed in the project, read from `.harness/harness.lock`.
HarnessStatePayload.title: HarnessStatePayload

InProcessObservation.description:
The ledger facts of an in-process worker, which has no step stream; `checkpoints` holds
the newest of the `checkpoint_count` it recorded.
InProcessObservation.title: InProcessObservation

IntegrationPayload.description:
One adapter of the Harness page: Claude Code or Codex (`runtime`: adapter files of the
installed capabilities, CLI on PATH) or the project tracker (`tracker`: CLI on PATH, null for
local work); nothing is checked online.
IntegrationPayload.title: IntegrationPayload

ObservedSelfReport.description: The model an in-process worker reported for itself.
ObservedSelfReport.title: ObservedSelfReport

OrchestrationStep.description: An orchestration event with the allowlisted fields its text needs.
OrchestrationStep.title: OrchestrationStep

PagedReply.description: The first page of a report body, a batch chronology or an update diff as JSON text.
PagedReply.title: PagedReply

PipelineUsage.description: Pipeline usage counted from the ledger; with `unavailable` every count is 0.
PipelineUsage.title: PipelineUsage

RosterDispatch.description:
A dispatch of the journal view; the timing is read for a live dispatch only ("" and
false otherwise), and the observation for an in-process dispatch only (null otherwise).
RosterDispatch.title: RosterDispatch

RuntimeStatusPayload.description:
Whether the project's runtime answered an empty `state.read` (2 s, never started), with its
store revision, or why it did not.
RuntimeStatusPayload.title: RuntimeStatusPayload

ScreenSnapshotReply.description: The first page of a screen snapshot's JSON text; `snapshot.page` reads the rest.
ScreenSnapshotReply.title: ScreenSnapshotReply

StepsRosterReply.description: The dispatches the live step list knows; `reset` drops the steps the client holds.
StepsRosterReply.title: StepsRosterReply

StorePayload.description:
The state authority read without the ledger lock; in the runtime-store epoch the audit count
comes from a bounded `state.validate` of the running runtime. Unread facts are null and
`reason` says why.
StorePayload.title: StorePayload

WorkerStepsPage.description: Allowlisted worker steps from a log byte offset; never thinking, tool inputs or raw JSON.
WorkerStepsPage.title: WorkerStepsPage

description: Text frames on /ws: one request object per frame, replies by id.
title: Console WebSocket protocol
